build_tracker_instance: build a MaskTrackRCNNTracker instance with custom match weights for det_score, iou, and det_label
create_match_score: create a match score tensor from current bboxes, labels, scores, and previous frame data
assign_tracking_ids: assign tracking IDs to current detections by matching against previous frame bounding boxes
run_tracking_forward: run the tracking forward pass on model features and data sample to get tracked instances
review_match_weights: review the MaskTrackRCNNTracker match weights configuration for det_score, iou, and det_label coefficients
